parse_django_workload_output: parse django-workload benchmark stdout to extract key metrics like transaction rate, throughput, and response time
parse_dw_data_helper: parse a metric value and unit from raw benchmark output data into a normalized metric name and float value
parse_dw_key_val_helper: parse a single django-workload output line into URL hit percentages or standard benchmark key-value metrics
calculate_django_score: calculate a normalized django benchmark score by dividing the transaction rate against the django baseline value
review_DjangoWorkloadParser: review the DjangoWorkloadParser class and its parse method to understand how siege benchmark output is parsed into metrics
